outcome: Canonical capability architecture cut over to the independent production registry
owner_impact: Neutral research-AI discovery now gets capability identity, generic meaning, implementation state/contracts and publication provenance only from the independent canonical capability registry. The two historical aggregation requests for RNG and heterogeneous state, plus the old implemented scalar request row, are retired as legacy workflow state. No scientific capability was removed or newly implemented; the clean baseline is intended so fresh acceptance can rediscover genuinely missing requirements without inherited paper-specific request context.

next.text: #335 is the known successor: a read-only fresh-session production audit of the exact deployed MCP/data surface. It has not started in this owner turn.

technical_evidence: The #348 migration refuses destructive cleanup unless the canonical registry is exactly the frozen 11 implemented capability keys and every capability has publication provenance.
Neutral read_workspace discovery calls list_canonical_capability_registry(); the obsolete request-derived list_canonical_capabilities() RPC is retired.
The three explicitly waived legacy capability-request rows are removed; the typed request workflow/table remains available for fresh requests.

The obsolete capability_requests canonical_definition/publication_provenance columns from #333 are retired; canonical semantics/provenance remain in canonical_capabilities and capability_publication_provenance.
MCP server/interface are 3.6.0/13; authoring contract remains vlab.authoring/0.7 and capability-request interface remains vlab.capability-request/4.

No simulator/kernel/physics, observation/action/runtime, Configuration/Initialization/Controller/Metrics syntax, Experiment artifact interface, or workspace RLS policy is changed by the cutover candidate.
